Definition: superlative of G3173; greatest or very great:--exceeding great.
BiblicalUsage: The word is the superlative, greatest, and Peter uses it once, of the promises: God has given us exceeding great and precious promises, that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the promises are exceeding great because they are God's own word, and they are precious because they make us partakers of His nature — the greatest gift is not a thing but a share in Him.
